review_candidates.title: Senior System Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: 𝐓𝐡𝐞 𝐎𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲 The Senior Systems Engineer is responsible for the operation, support, and continuous enhancement of infrastructure and cloud services delivered by GO2 Solutions to its customers and business partners. Maintain accurate ticket updates, closure evidence, timesheets, configuration records, runbooks and knowledge articles. Prove: maintain current work notes and provide meaningful closure, validation and customer outcome evidence. Sustain: maintain runbooks, knowledge, onboarding art
eligibility_evidence: 𝐄𝐬𝐬𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐚𝐥 𝐓𝐞𝐜𝐡𝐧𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐥 𝐒𝐤𝐢𝐥𝐥𝐬 Strong troubleshooting capability across Windows Server 2019/2022/2025, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, certificate services and hybrid identity.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure Arc or comparable hybrid cloud services.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This role combines advanced Level 2 and Level 3 operational engineering expertise with strong service ownership, evidence-based delivery practices, and an automation-first mindset. Conduct all activities in accordance with GO2 Solutions policies, security requirements, quality standards and customer obligations. Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365, Azure Arc or comparable hybrid cloud services. Current hands-on capability and evidence of delivery are more important than legacy certification titles.

review_candidates.title: IT Network Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This organization leverages technology to enhance the lives of those they serve, maintaining a robust and reliable IT infrastructure. Install, maintain, and monitor computer network hardware and software, including troubleshooting network problems. Plan, implement, and maintain server and PC infrastructure, both local and remote. Troubleshoot Microsoft Exchange/Exchange Online and Microsoft Office 365, and virtualize applications for redundancy.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Proficiency with Microsoft products, including Windows Server, cloud technologies, and current workstation OS versions.
